notes: Corrected: the lamed of levilti hamit no longer holds the ASV's coordinating and. Rule 14's closing sentence is explicit that a preposition whose own relation the ASV leaves unstated is unrepresented under rule 40 rather than a home for a coordinator, and rule 26 confirms the default by carving out only the len X leY case. Counting the clause's conjunctions against the ASV's connectives leaves the and in surplus, so it is its own added unit.
The infinitive absolute takes at all and the finite verb keeps do ... hide (rule 56).
Only one determiner is written for ha-ish ha-hu; the demonstrative pronoun takes it and both articles are unrepresented.
